fieldNotes.site: Confirmed as Caterpillar Distribution Center DC-2, 6611 Hoke Rd, Clayton OH - a 1.6M sq ft parts DC opened 2011. CATERPILLAR monument sign at the Hoke Rd entrance confirmed in Street View. Roster geocode (39.842875, -84.335057, ROOFTOP, moved 4040m) landed on the building. Imagery is winter/snow-covered, reducing fine-detail confidence.
fieldNotes.truckGate: Defined entry driveway off Hoke Rd leading to a pinch-point at the building; a small structure (blue-roof booth) sits at the entry point - consistent with a controlled gate. truckGate set true.
fieldNotes.guardShack: A small booth-like structure straddling/beside the entry-lane pinch point is visible in z19/z20 satellite, partly obscured by snow. Classed as a guard shack at medium confidence; flagged.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Wide entry driveway/apron at the controlled point gives room for an express bypass lane.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Long dock-door bank confirmed on the west building face with trailers backed in. 50+ band; exact count low confidence due to snow.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Very large drop yard on the SE side packed with parked trailers (90+) and rows of stored equipment/material; 50+ band.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: Long entry drive and a truck route circling the very large building - ample queueing room.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Edge-of-town Clayton OH amid farmland off Hoke Rd; classed Rural per rubric.
fieldNotes.railServed: No rail spur into the property.
fieldNotes.scale: No truck scale identified; left false.
fieldNotes.metrics: Counts are honest estimates from snow-covered overhead imagery of a 1.6M sq ft DC; flagged.
